assumptions: 100 nH + 20 mOhm wiring + 5 mOhm in-line 15 A ATO fuse (MARGIN_PRESCRIPTION P0-3b)
Logic load on BAT_IN through U9
28 ohm (~0.3 A at 8.4 V); U9 itself not modelled, RAW_PROTECTED = BAT_IN x enable
Littelfuse 217 series 5 A fast-acting 5x20 (0217005): cold R 13.7 mOhm, nominal melting I2t 42.8 A2s (datasheet table); modelled as opening when the integrated I2t reaches 42.8 A2s (arc time ignored)
the R1 hold-up study (docs/SIMULATION.md) gives only ~3 ms of VLOGIC hold-up at 6.0 V / 0.5 A; any BAT_IN collapse longer than that resets the MCU
MJG bridgewire 1.2 ohm + 1 m 26 AWG (134 mOhm) + 1 uH lead (MARGIN_PRESCRIPTION fire row)
4.385 ohm each, 1.096 ohm for all four (GEOMETRY_REV_G); cruise 1.5 A total
10 ns contact edge, two bounces (on 10 us, off 12 us, on 14 us, off 15 us, on 17 us)
ADC total error used for state separation
